state.project: Rebuild Kingstree-Hemingway 115 kV Line as a Double Circuit 230/115 kV Line
state.description: Construct a second 230 kV line, approximately 22 miles, from the Kingstree 230 kV Switching Station to the Hemingway 230-115 kV Substation by rebuilding the existing Kingstree – Hemingway 115 kV line for double circuit 230/115 kV construction.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
